information.information: Only AB feasible; neither endpoint verified; each bundle deterministically verifies its endpoint. Values are immediate maximum matching counts, with no query cost subtraction.
Two independent Bernoulli candidate-partner edges revealed by each batch; matching chosen after reveal. Shared batch p=4/5, distinct p=7/10.
AB state is high/low equiprobably; reveal exposes state before choosing AB/AC. Forgone disjoint hard opportunity is represented by additive cost 1/4.

One fair shared regime controls later alternatives B/C. An earlier disjoint pair retires without reward but publicly reveals regime; its endpoints never return. Other endpoints remain. No-return alone does not imply zero learning value.

inherited_nonmonotone_occupancy.scope: Isolated current AB introduction, no retirement; independent future AC opportunity only on day 3. Reward not required to be a subset of retirement.
